talents.name: Wall breaker
talents.effect: When your CYBER ATTACK deals SYSTEM damage, your rolls are LUCKY.

talents.name: When in doubt C12
talents.effect: When using explosives you can make an ENGINEERING check to remove up to 20 degree of radius from the explosion radius per success.

talents.name: Backup Plan
talents.effect: Any IDs you present or create are always valid against DEVICES, MACHINES, AI's or TRONIKS.

talents.name: Fix Nature
talents.effect: You can remove any negative parts of your Background or Race (other than starting racial attributes). Those negative effects no longer apply to you.

talents.name: Predictive Model
talents.effect: When a target repeats an action against you, that it already performed during this SCENE; You gain a LARGE bonus to your DEFENSE.

talents.name: Prince of pain
talents.effect: You have perfected the art of causing suffering. When dealing damage with a MELEE attack you apply a VULNERABILITY 1 to ALL (ailment, cummulative) and can change the damage type to STUN.

talents.name: Symbiotic Piloting
talents.effect: When using OPERATOR to control a vehicle. HANDLING increases by 3 (max 10), HULL by 1 and any crew on board have a SMALL bonus to any skill check that uses the vehicle.

talents.name: The Red Pill
talents.effect: Drugs you administer last twice as long and have a 50% Increased effect (round up), when applicable. No effects on drugs without numerical values or durations.

talents.name: Armstrong
talents.effect: You have somehow figured out that might applies to all aspects of life. You can replace the ATTRIBUTE bonus of all skill checks with PHYSICAL if you chose so.

talents.name: Digital Ghost
talents.effect: Your mind takes a form for itself, you can perform HACKING, OPERATOR or CYBERINTEL actions during MAINTENANCE. Those actions cost MORALE instead of CPU. Max MORALE per turn is equal to WITS.

talents.name: Geno morph
talents.effect: Your body can morph between two entirely different set of genetic EVO. (Requires a full REST to change)

talents.name: Insane Genius
talents.effect: You can create plans for an item that breaks the rules (One time GM approval)

talents.name: Internal logic
talents.effect: You can store one PROGRAM or ROUTINE inside your mind. It no longer cost CPU or MEMORY, cannot be scanned, found or hacked by anyone but it can only be used by you and cannot be shared with anyone.

talents.name: Limitless Potential
talents.effect: One of your TIER 3 EVO, chosen at random, has evolved to TIER 4 (GM's Decision).

talents.name: Perfect Ghost
talents.effect: If you die in the same round that you performed a CYBERINTEL, HACKING or OPERATOR action, as a free action, you can store a FULL backup of yourself on the device you used the skill check on.

talents.name: Play God
talents.effect: Create your own race with GM approval. (Neutral stat distribution, 1 racial , evolution and environment trait)

talents.name: Soul anchor
talents.effect: Should you die, you can as a FREE action pull your past self and come back to life instantly as you were at any moment during the last SCENE. This cannot occur more than once per full rest.

talents.name: The answer is 42
talents.effect: You know one of the secret of the universe, that knowledge is unexplained but grants you a serious advantage (GM choice)

talents.name: Alley Rat
talents.effect: You have a knack for finding the best escape routes and making your pursuers lives miserable. When being chased in an URBAN environment anyone following you is in difficult terrain.

talents.name: Beginners Luck
talents.effect: When rolling any SOCIAL skills in which you have a skill rank of less than 4 you get a SMALL bonus on all roll as everyone attributes any of your mistakes to a lack of training.

talents.name: Blind Confidence
talents.effect: You mount or trained beasts can use all of your DEFENSIVE attributes instead of it's own when in your company.

talents.name: Con Artist
talents.effect: You are great at fooling people and dragging them into your elaborate plans. You have a SMALL bonus when using social skills to fool, con or lie to people.

talents.name: Coordinated strike
talents.effect: Whenever someone with the Coordinated Strike talent makes an INITIATIVE check, Any other player with the Coordinated Strike talent can act at that initiative instead of rolling theirs.

talents.name: Crowd Fighter
talents.effect: When fighting in a populated urban environment you can use bystanders as GOOD cover

talents.name: Culture Knack
talents.effect: You have a knack for fitting in.  If you spend at least a SCENE in an environment, you gain a SMALL bonus to ETIQUETTE and STREETWISE checks made in that environment.

talents.name: Extorsion
talents.effect: On a successful INTIMIDATE check you gain a LARGE bonus to any SOCIAL skill against the target. Relationship level with the target will drop by 2 after the deal.

talents.name: Faking it
talents.effect: You can attempt to use ETIQUETTE or FLAIR with a SMALL penalty to impress/intimidate a target instead of INTIMIDATE. However if you fail, you ridicule yourself and lose your result as MORALE.

talents.name: Family connexions
talents.effect: All contacts of the same race as yourself count as 1 level higher.

talents.name: Fast Friends
talents.effect: People tend to trust you and befriend you quickly, every successful social challenge with an adversary will improve their disposition by 1.

talents.name: Fence
talents.effect: You have a second innate sense when  figuring out who might accept illegal goods. On a successful STREETWISE check you know if a normal merchant will do illegal deals.

talents.name: Good Cop Bad Cop
talents.effect: If you have a partner when performing a SOCIAL challenge and they also have this talent, your partner can reroll your SOCIAL skill (using their scores) and you can reroll theirs (once per round).

talents.name: Greaseball
talents.effect: You are kind of shady. When making SOCIAL checks you have a LARGE bonus in dealing with criminals but a SMALL penalty with non criminals.

talents.name: Hide in plain sight
talents.effect: When in a crowd you automatically gain passive CONCEALMENT at a level equal to your STREETWISE.

talents.name: Hostile Takeover
talents.effect: You can purchase what is not for sale: If you faill a NEGOTIATION check against AVAILABILITY you can multiply and pay the AVAILABILITY DC of an item in credits to force a success.

talents.name: Human Supremacy
talents.effect: Gain a small bonus on social interactions involving other HUMANS only.

talents.name: I know Johnny
talents.effect: You can add the value of a relevant contact to your dice pool when making SOCIAL checks. Doing so exposes your contact and may lead to consequences.

talents.name: I tried being nice
talents.effect: If you attempt a CHARM roll and failed, your can try again using INTIMIDATE with a LARGE bonus.

talents.name: I'm innocent, I swear
talents.effect: You have a SMALL bonus to any SKILL check used to explain something you are being accused of.

talents.name: Impressionist
talents.effect: If you performed a successful INTUITION, SCAN or TACTICS check against someone you gain a LARGE bonus to ACTING checks to pass yourself off as that target.

talents.name: Instigator
talents.effect: You're great at starting shit and not being seen as the instigator. When a SOCIAL challenge results in combat you always start the fight with free CONCEALMENT.

talents.name: Legal Smuggling
talents.effect: You can disguise the legality of items you own or smuggle. Gain a LARGE bonus to any SOCIAL skill used to explain or conceal the legality of an item.

talents.name: Magic Adept
talents.effect: You gain mastery of a spell. (can be taken multiple times)

talents.name: Mitigating Circumstances
talents.effect: If you used a non combat social skill against a target(s) prior to combat, your SOAK rolls are at maximum value against that target(s) during the first combat round of that SCENE.

talents.name: Pacifist
talents.effect: When an opponent surrenders peacefully or you avoid combat through a SOCIAL skill check you regain your WILLPOWER in morale

talents.name: Propaganda
talents.effect: If you use a SOCIAL skill that causes a MORALE hit in a non combat setting you can double the morale loss.

talents.name: Red Tape
talents.effect: You know enough about official procedures to delay or accelerate most procedures by an additional 10% per success.

talents.name: Roger that
talents.effect: When following directions given by someone else you have a SMALL bonus to any skill check required to complete that task.

talents.name: Self medicating
talents.effect: When a DRUG you take results in a TOXIC SHOCK roll you double the effects of that DRUG for it's duration.

talents.name: Skip Bullshit
talents.effect: Every extra success you get in a SOCIAL check can modify the price of purchased or sold items by 10% (max 50%)

talents.name: Social adept
talents.effect: When an ally uses an ASSIST action on you. gain all of their SOCIAL TALENTS until the end of the turn.

talents.name: Socialite
talents.effect: You are great at dealing with famous people. Gain a SMALL bonus to all SOCIAL checks made when interacting with anyone with any ranks of FAME or INFAMY.

talents.name: Street Fighter
talents.effect: As long as you are in an urban environment, you can improvise a Knife, Nightstick or Staff from things around you as a free action.

talents.name: Striking Looks
talents.effect: You are an exceptionally attractive sample of your specie, add a SMALL bonus to SOCIAL rolls when interacting with compatible partners.

talents.name: Trendsetter
talents.effect: You appearance is legendary. As long all of your visible equipment and items are of LIMITED rarity or higher you have a SMALL bonus to your SOCIAL ATTRIBUTE.

talents.name: Trumpspeak
talents.effect: You are adept at communicating with lesser forms of intelligence. Gain a LARGE bonus to all social skills when target is under 0 MENTAL but a SMALL penalty against anyone over 0 MENTAL.

talents.name: Walking Menace
talents.effect: Your EVOs are terryfying. Any SKILL checks against you that triggers an EVO modified roll will cause a 10m visual panic to those that can see it (Tier of the EVO used Vs their WITS or must run/take cover)

talents.name: Well connected
talents.effect: Gain a SMALL bonus when using NEGOTIATION to check for availability against an existing contact. Bonus increases to LARGE if the contact is specific (Arms dealers for a weapon etc).

talents.name: You talk too much
talents.effect: If someone use a SOCIAL skill on you, you have LARGE bonus to DMG against that person on your next action.

talents.name: Act like you belong
talents.effect: A successful ETIQUETTE checks grants a LARGE bonus to CONCEALMENT when in an environment that requires an ETIQUETTE roll.

talents.name: As seen on TV!
talents.effect: You can use an ACTING, CHARM or SUBTERFUGE check to replace any MENTAL skill check but with a LARGE penalty; everyone is convinced that you know what you are doing.

talents.name: Cooperative Spellcasting
talents.effect: When an ally with cooperative spellcasting talent is within spell range, If both cast the same spell, in the same round, you combine the Skill roll of both spell casters into one single powerful spell. (Max result 10).

talents.name: Deep ties
talents.effect: When interacting with anyone who is part of your contact list (allies and enemies) your SOCIAL checks have a LARGE bonus

talents.name: Emotional Processing
talents.effect: You have somehow figured out exactly how emotions and feelings work. You can give yourself a SMALL bonus on any skill check that could be tied to an emotional state

talents.name: Ex. Cop
talents.effect: When using SOCIAL skills in an illegal context you gain a LARGE bonus or penalty depending on circumstances.

talents.name: Fake News
talents.effect: You are great at convincing people that their knowledge is wrong. A succesful SOCIAL skill check vs WILLPOWER to apply a LARGE penalty to a MENTAL skill an opponent is performing.

talents.name: Fascinating Orator
talents.effect: When in a SOCIAL challenge you get one chance to recover from a failure. (reroll any skill checks once per challenge).

talents.name: Fear of death
talents.effect: When trying to INTIMIDATE someone gain a LARGE bonus to you roll if the target has any TRAUMA.

talents.name: Healer
talents.effect: When one of your actions recovers the target's HEALTH or MORALE you elminiate one TRAUMA if the amount recovered exceeds the target's WILLPOWER or ENDURANCE.

talents.name: Infamous
talents.effect: You have truly learned to use your race's bad rep to your advantage. If your INFAMY is higher than the target's WITS you gain a LARGE bonus to hostile SOCIAL actions.

talents.name: Instant motivation
talents.effect: Troops, allies or units you command gain a SURGE whenever one of your LEADERSHIP rolls was a Critical Success.

talents.name: Jabberwocky
talents.effect: With at least 1 week of preparation, you can create a "real" lie, even random people will know about it and believe in it. DC8 to find out the truth.

talents.name: Look alive
talents.effect: Make a LEADERSHIP check as a STANDARD action Vs the WILLPOWER of all allies within earshot. Success, refresh the QUICK action of that ally.

talents.name: Look out!
talents.effect: As a QUICK interrupt you can make a LEADERSHIP check with to grant X additional HEALTH SOAK to one ally in hearing range. All other allies in range gain a SMALL bonus to SOAK

talents.name: Look over there
talents.effect: Allies have a SMALL bonus to ALL SKILLS against targets that were affected by any of your SOCIAL skills until the next maintenance phase.

talents.name: Metabeing
talents.effect: Gain a SMALL bonus to all SOCIAL skill checks as long as the DC does not exceed your EVO total.

talents.name: No mercy
talents.effect: The power of all your attacks when an enemy is suffering from TRAUMA is increased by 1 category. (Max [HIGH]).

talents.name: Oh Captain, My Captain
talents.effect: When performing an ASSIST action, you can help out using LEADERSHIP instead of any other skills.

talents.name: Or Else
talents.effect: You can use INTIMIDATE checks instead of any other SOCIAL skill but your roll suffers a LARGE penalty.

talents.name: Ordinary Joe
talents.effect: For some reason you look like everybody, people tend to forget anything specific about you. You have an SMALL bonus to WITS and WILLPOWER defense against SOCIAL skills.

talents.name: Power though!
talents.effect: As a QUICK interrupt you can make a LEADERSHIP check with to grant X additional MORALE SOAK to one ally in hearing range. All other allies in range gain a SMALL bonus to SOAK.

talents.name: Precognition
talents.effect: You sometimes have glimpses of the future. Once per SCENE you can reroll your luck dice or automatically win INITIATIVE.

talents.name: Razor's Edge
talents.effect: When using RAW CHI your control rolls are lucky.

talents.name: Secret Identity
talents.effect: You're well trained at maintaining secret identities. Anyone attempting to uncover who you really are suffers a LARGE penalty.

talents.name: Selective Psychosis
talents.effect: When you trigger an EVO based AILMENT, you can replace an existing AILMENT with it.

talents.name: Shocking
talents.effect: When wounding a target with a CRITICAL HIT or cause a SEVERE TRAUMA, you cause all enemies in visual range to also lose a point of MORALE.

talents.name: Sociopath
talents.effect: Anytime you deal a CRITICAL HIT or cause a TRAUMA, you restore 1 MORALE to yourself

talents.name: Street shopping
talents.effect: When using STREETWISE to find non legal goods, your AVAILABILITY result is increased by 1. If you exceed the needed availibility for an item you were looking for you also negate the legality tax.

talents.name: The greatest distraction
talents.effect: When you use a SOCIAL skill in a challenge, all of your allies have a SMALL bonus to ACUITY skill checks until next maintenance.

talents.name: Virtual God
talents.effect: You can use your MENTAL attribute instead of your SOCIAL for any SOCIAL skills against machines or devices.

talents.name: Weaponized Fear
talents.effect: As long as your morale is full you gain a LARGE bonus on all skills checks against MACHINES, TRONIK, BOTS, ROBOTS and AI's.

talents.name: Working the crowd
talents.effect: When 2 or more allies are in a SCENE with you, you can include them in your ACTING role. Your acting roll now counts for them as well.

talents.name: Best Friend
talents.effect: People never hate you, at worst they may dislike you, improve liking of everyone by 1 category. (Friendly, Appreciative, Neutral, Disliked, Hated)

talents.name: Compassion
talents.effect: Whenever you restore HEALTH to a target or yourself, you restore an equal amount of MORALE and vice-versa.

talents.name: Curse Weaver
talents.effect: AILMENTS you inflict are hard to recover from. Target recovery rolls are UNLUCKY

talents.name: Despair
talents.effect: You cause double morale loss to any enemy in your veil range.

talents.name: Disturbing
talents.effect: Your behavior is extremely alien to other races, when singled out by SOCIAL skills you have LARGE bonus to all of your DEFENSES.

talents.name: Enthrall
talents.effect: You have a gift when it comes to occupying people's attention. Any target of one of your SOCIAL skill checks suffers a LARGE penalty to any actions not directed against you.

talents.name: I didin't see anything
talents.effect: On a successful SUBTERFUGE Vs target's WITS, Once per SCENE you can convince the target to ignore one action they just witnessed. Roll has a LARGE or SMALL penalty if the action is hard to ignore.

talents.name: Living Horror
talents.effect: Any MORALE damage you deal gains the CRIT special modifier or improve critical range if it already had it.

talents.name: Poker Face
talents.effect: You get a SMALL bonus to WITS checks. This bonus can exceed your maximum racial value.

talents.name: Predict Actions
talents.effect: Once per SOCIAL challenge you can ask the DM for the result of a SOCIAL action before you decide to use it

talents.name: Psychological deterent
talents.effect: When using a MARKSMAN attack from CONCEALMENT, any HEALTH based attack will also damage MORALE until you are spotted.

talents.name: Rabid Fans
talents.effect: When challenged in a crowded environment where you are known, people will rush to defend you. Opponents have a LARGE penalty to all skill checks.

talents.name: Starstruck
talents.effect: People are in awe of you. Everyone that attempts to make any SKILL checks against you have a SMALL penalty.

talents.name: Bolstering Veil
talents.effect: Allies in range of your Veil cannot drop lower than your current morale

talents.name: EVO's what EVO?
talents.effect: Your EVO's do not cause the usual drawbacks of having EVO rank 1, 2 and 3.

talents.name: Pain specialist
talents.effect: If your damage cause a TRAUMA, check the damage against the target's WILLPOWER and ENDURANCE. If the damage exceeds the other one too, the target gains the TRAUMA on both pools.

talents.name: Death Veil
talents.effect: When enemies within your veil suffer a morale loss, they take an equal amount of health damage in addition to the morale loss.

talents.name: Multiple Personality
talents.effect: Gain one additional Background allowed to your race.  (GM's Approval)

talents.name: Perfect Actor
talents.effect: On a critical success with ACTING, when passing yourself, as another race, you also gain their RACIAL traits while maintaining the role.

talents.name: Spiritual Genesis
talents.effect: You can create a new SPELL or BARRIER. This is unique to you, does not count against the limit of your spirit and cannot be learned or counterspelled by anyone else. (Final effect subjected to GM's approval)

talents.name: Trueborn Sorcerer
talents.effect: You can pay the CHI cost of any spells using a willing ally's CHI within the spell range. Direct hits with your spells makes targets count as willing allies for the purpose of this ability until the end of the SCENE.

talents.name: Bounty Hunter
talents.effect: When engaged in a challenge with a target you investigated prior to that SCENE, you gain SMALL bonus to all your rolls against that same target.

talents.name: CHI Surge
talents.effect: You can add any amount of your own personal CHI to the RAW pool as a QUICK action

talents.name: Close Quarters
talents.effect: You can use Tiny and Small ranged weapons in melee without giving COUNTER attacks.

talents.name: Counter Magics
talents.effect: When you successful defend vs a spell you gain LARGE bonus on the next CHI power you use. (bonus is lost if not used in the same scene.)

talents.name: Don't Panic
talents.effect: During a surprise round you have a SMALL bonus to all of your DEFENSES

talents.name: Eagle Eyed
talents.effect: Removes penalty on medium range attacks and reduce long range penalty to a SMALL penalty.

talents.name: Energy Transfer
talents.effect: You can spend personal CHI as a free action during mainternance to reduce the recharge of a device by 1 round per CHI spent.

talents.name: Escape Artist
talents.effect: You are trained at escaping bonds and restraints. Gain a LARGE bonus to DEXTERITY or ATHLETICS checks made to escape bindings and holds.

talents.name: Fast Change
talents.effect: You can use a COMPLEX action to change into or out of disguise. Provides a LARGE bonus to CONCEALEMENT if you were not seen during the change.

talents.name: Fated magic
talents.effect: When using CHI (personal or RAW), you add a SMALL bonus to all numeric values if your luck roll was a success or a SMALL penalty on failure. Transform to LARGE if luck roll was a critical success/failure.

talents.name: Finger in the Hole
talents.effect: You can use and navigate Wormholes allowing travel to areas not covered by gates (Modifies travel time by +/- 100%) but your NAVIGATION skill check has a LARGE penalty to figure out where you will end up.

talents.name: Galactic Shortcut
talents.effect: When travelling on established routes you always cut down travel times by 10% per success above what was required. (Max 50%).

talents.name: Hole in one
talents.effect: You decide in which direction your DEVIATION goes.

talents.name: Impalement Artist
talents.effect: SMALL and TINY melee thrown weapons all gain the QUICK keyword.

talents.name: Infiltrate
talents.effect: When a CONCEALMENT skill checks is made by someone with the INFILTRATE talent everyone else with the INFILTRATE talent can pick that roll instead of theirs.

talents.name: Inner peace
talents.effect: Anytime you restore HEALTH or MORALE via skills, items or magic to a target other than yourself, you recover 1 MORALE.

talents.name: Keen senses
talents.effect: AWARENESS checks have no penalties from visual impairments like darkness, smoke, fog.

talents.name: Mr. Smith
talents.effect: You know how to look as normal as possible. Gain a LARGE bonus to CONCEALMENT when making rolls in a crowded area (more than 10 people).

talents.name: Navigate Blind
talents.effect: You do not suffer any penalties when navigating in unknown environments.

talents.name: Omens
talents.effect: Your AWARENESS (including passive) can now detect paranormal as well.

talents.name: Opportunist
talents.effect: During a surprise round you initiated, all your rolls are lucky

talents.name: Overwhelming presence
talents.effect: The bonus from your VEIL is increased to LARGE when you can TOUCH your target.

talents.name: Psychometry
talents.effect: You can take 30 minutes to feel the last 24h of an object or a person. Roll INTUITION, the info you get is tied to your roll result.

talents.name: Running Reload
talents.effect: As long as you have a free hand you can reload your weapon while performing another action by taking a SMALL penalty to that action  (except shoot that weapon obviously).

talents.name: Shadowrun
talents.effect: You can run while in CONCEALMENT but take a LARGE penalty to your result. (If it lowers your CONCEALMENT to 0 or less, you are visible to everyone).

talents.name: Sharpshooter
talents.effect: If you perform an AIM action, you can skip the SMALL bonus to instead ignore all range penalties.

talents.name: Smuggling
talents.effect: When concealing items on your person search attempts will be unlucky.

talents.name: Spell slinger
talents.effect: When casting spells through RELIC SHARDS you can use a DEXTERITY check to throw the relic into a target. This roll determines if the spell hits or not.

talents.name: Star Compass
talents.effect: You always know where you are in the galaxy. Gain a LARGE bonus to any ACUITY check where knowing where you are is important.

talents.name: Tactical Deployment
talents.effect: If you rolled a TACTICS Vs the enemy WITS before a scene, at the start of the combat, once everyone is in place but before any actions are taken, you can reposition yourself by X meters

talents.name: Tactical Insight
talents.effect: In the first round of combat as a QUICK action you can roll TACTICS Vs ENEMY WITS if you succeed your entire team automatically wins initiative checks until next MAINTENANCE.

talents.name: The Best Distraction
talents.effect: You can attempt to use DEXTERITY to steal items that are Larger than small with a (SMALL penalty) or being held (LARGE penalty).

talents.name: Treasure Hunter
talents.effect: You have a LARGE bonus when using SEARCH to find hidden doors, safes or concealed treasures.

talents.name: Unnatural Predator
talents.effect: When attacking from CONCEALMENT you can chose what damage type you want to do (PHYSICAL, ENERGY, TECH, SPIRITUAL)

talents.name: You're a Natural
talents.effect: When an ally uses an ASSIST action on you. gain all of their ACUITY TALENTS until the end of the turn.

talents.name: Acute senses
talents.effect: One of your senses (pick one when you select this talent) is highly developed. SEARCH checks that rely on that sense exclusively are LUCKY.

talents.name: Always Alert
talents.effect: You have a permanent SMALL bonus to your passive AWARENESS

talents.name: Blindsight
talents.effect: When targets are within your hearing or smell range (50m) you do not suffer from any range penalty and ignore visual impairments.

talents.name: Counter-Intel
talents.effect: You can perform  a TACTICS checks as a FREE action each maintenance phase but you have a SMALL penalty.

talents.name: Critical weakness
talents.effect: When successfully using TACTICS to identify a target, until the end of the scene; you increase CRITICAL range by 1 against vs that same enemy.

talents.name: Defensive reoload
talents.effect: When performing a RELOAD action or during a RECHARGE action you increase all your DEFENSES by 1 category against anyone over 50m from your position.

talents.name: First strike
talents.effect: You always roll twice when checking for INITIATIVE, pick either result.

talents.name: Guerilla
talents.effect: You get a full round instead of a single action during your surprise round

talents.name: Hunker Down
talents.effect: When you lose CONCEALMENT from being spotted, you have a LARGE bonus to all your defenses until the next maintenance phase.

talents.name: I Know You!
talents.effect: If you rolled tactics to identify an enemy before combat, during the combat scene you have a SMALL bonus to all rolls made against that target.

talents.name: Mind reader
talents.effect: Use a QUICK action to roll INTUITION vs the target's WITS to predict all of its actions for the following round. Your DEFENSES have a LARGE bonus against the target actions until next MAINTENANCE.

talents.name: MOB mentality
talents.effect: When using the same SKILL as an ally on the same target you increase your critical range by 1 category.

talents.name: Mugging
talents.effect: You can attempt to pick pocket a tiny object when making a successful melee attack as a free action. Roll (DEXTERITY Vs SPEED). Must have a free hand.

talents.name: My Precious!
talents.effect: You gain twice as much Relic experience for the purpose of making magical items

talents.name: Nightstalker
talents.effect: When dealing with opponents suffering from environmental penalties you gain a LARGE bonus to SKILL checks and  DAMAGE.

talents.name: Peephole
talents.effect: You can perform NAVIGATION checks with a LARGE penalty to know the layout of a room behind a closed door.

talents.name: Persistent spirit
talents.effect: When you are RESTING ; your spirit remains active and you can SUSTAIN effects.

talents.name: Ranger veteran
talents.effect: When in a SCENE with someone else with the Ranger Veteran talent, whenever you are attacking the same target, one of you can instead add their marksman result to the other player.

talents.name: Shadow form
talents.effect: All of your MAGIC powers have INV  (Can be used from concealment without any penalty when no enemy are within 10m)

talents.name: Shardslinger
talents.effect: Enemies attempting to COUNTERSPELL spells you use through a RELIC have a LARGE penality to their skill check.

talents.name: Share Chi
talents.effect: You can tap a target for their CHI by touching them. (Martial arts required for unwilling targets).

talents.name: Shared Bonds
talents.effect: When binding a target or his spirit you gain the benefits of its magical EVO's if any.

talents.name: Shortcut
talents.effect: You can attempt to find a shortcut when none is apparent. Cut down travel time by 50% but your NAVIGATION skill check has a LARGE penalty to figure out where you end up.

talents.name: Sniff out weakness
talents.effect: When attacking a target that has a DEFENSIVE penalty of any kind (Flanked, Prone, Restrained etc.), you gain a LARGE bonus to DAMAGE and increase POWER by 1 category (Max [HIGH]).

talents.name: Soul thief
talents.effect: When targeted by any effect that cost CHI you gain the CHI spent by the caster as your own. The CHI is not added to the RAW pool.

talents.name: Spiritual reprograming
talents.effect: You have attained enlightenment; your maximum CHI is now 3 and you can gain SPIRITS, SPELLS and POWERS.

talents.name: Subtle Veil
talents.effect: You influence your veil ability to change your features, you gain a SMALL bonus to ACUITY checks vs targets within your veil range.

talents.name: Therapy by proxy
talents.effect: PSYLONS can ignore a MORALE TRAUMA by passing it to a willing ally within 10m. On a successful INTUITION + LARGE penalty Vs a target's WITS you can pass it to an unwilling target.

talents.name: Throwing expert
talents.effect: You are an expert at throwing items. You can duel wield throwing items without any penalty and can throw at different targets.

talents.name: Total Absence
talents.effect: When using CONCEALMENT you can take a LARGE penalty to have type II (electronic) and type III (psychic) concealment as well

talents.name: Trick Shot
talents.effect: You can perform attacks that normally require COMPLEX actions as a REGULAR action instead of COMPLEX but the attack has a LARGE penalty.

talents.name: Unveiled Truths
talents.effect: Any target within your VEIL range has a LARGE penalty to CONCEALMENT, SUBTERFUGE and any skills check used to lie or pass as someone they are not.

talents.name: Assassination
talents.effect: If you used a non damaging ACUITY skill against a target; your next combat skill check against the target is a CRITICAL success with SMALL bonus to DAMAGE or a LARGE one if you used two ACUITY skills.

talents.name: Back to Back
talents.effect: When fighting next to an ally with the Back to Back talent you can make defensive rolls (DEFEND, DEFLECT and SOAK) for one another. Damage goes to the intended target regardless of who defended against it.

talents.name: Circus Performer
talents.effect: All of your DEXTERITY skill checks counts their targets as BREACHED

talents.name: Enslaver
talents.effect: Gain a SMALL bonus to all SKILLS and DAMAGE while binding an enemy AWAKENED SPIRIT, or LARGE one if the SPIRIT is MANIFESTED. Bonus is loss if the SPIRIT or it's owner DIES.

talents.name: Fast shadow
talents.effect: While in CONCEALMENT your movement speed is no longer reduced.

talents.name: Instant Stealth
talents.effect: You can enter CONCEALMENT even while in plain sight but suffer a LARGE penalty.

talents.name: Make it count
talents.effect: Your PRECISION HIT (no burst or full auto) at long range have their POWER increased by 2 categories (Max [EXTREME]).

talents.name: Neat Trick
talents.effect: When taking a COMPLEX action to shoot, if your EXPERTISE result is 5 or more you can discard it's bonus and replace it with any SPECIAL property normally allowed on that weapon.

talents.name: Pistolier
talents.effect: All pistols have CRIT when you fire them, increase critical range by 1 if it already had it.

talents.name: Slippery
talents.effect: You get a SMALL bonus to SPEED checks. This bonus can exceed your maximum racial value.

talents.name: Snipe
talents.effect: All PRECISION MARKSMAN attacks done at long range from CONCEALMENT are always CRITICAL hits.

talents.name: Void touched
talents.effect: Your Blood of Aiur no longer grants additional CHI. Instead, your base CHI is added to any DEFENSIVE ATTRIBUTES (Max 10) when defending against MAGIC. You can no longer use PERSONAL CHI for SPELLS.

talents.name: Combat Trance
talents.effect: When engaged in combat you gain a LARGE bonus to your WITS and WILLPOWER defense.

talents.name: Ghost arms
talents.effect: Anytime you use an ELEMENTALIST spell or power you manifest a spiritual arms during that round. While the arms are in play, they can perform one STANDARD non spell action of your choice.

talents.name: Homunculus
talents.effect: When taking HEALTH damage that results in a TRAUMA, the next round your blood animates into a version of yourself. The Homunculus will last one round and can cast any of your SPELLS without CHI.

talents.name: Mana Leech
talents.effect: Your NATURAL attacks have SPIRITBANE, in addition, anyone touching, damaging or striking you loses one point of CHI (per action).  Any CHI lost by this effect is added to your CHI pool.

talents.name: Atomic Nomz Nomz
talents.effect: You are fully immune from any form of ENERGY damage. You just feel a slight tingling when an ENERGY attacks hit you.

talents.name: God Mode
talents.effect: If you successfully rolled a TACTIC check before combat. You can cancel one action of your choice (yours, enemy or ally) during the next SCENE. Action will have no effect.

talents.name: Ninja
talents.effect: You can use any skills or perform any action while CONCEALED without incuring penalties to your CONCEALMENT.

talents.name: Obliteration
talents.effect: Enemies defense against your MAGIC powers have unlucky rolls.

talents.name: Perfect predator
talents.effect: Your direct (non aoe) attacks all have X-ALL

talents.name: Playing with Dark Forces
talents.effect: Create an exclusive GOD tier RELIC. Check with GM for details.

talents.name: Ricochet
talents.effect: You can shoot and throw items across corners. Ignore Line of Sight rules and COVER if you can hit the target as long as there is a path to them.

talents.name: Voltaic metabolism
talents.effect: When hit by an energy attack, if you cast an ELEMENTALIST spell as a QUICK reaction you take no damage and the spell cost no CHI.
